_comment: Exterior modular structure template (PROCGEN_EXTERIOR.md §9). Backs the 'C++: Conjure Keep' spell and the generate_structure adapter action. piece = vanilla EditorID or '0x..~Mod.esp'. at = LOCAL coords relative to the structure origin (forward units in front of the caster). rot_z in DEGREES. repeat = {axis, step, count} expands one entry into N stepped pieces (auto wall runs). anchor_ground=true snaps that piece's Z to land height (foundations/gate); other pieces use the flatten_to_max base plane. THESE EDITORIDS NEED IN-GAME VALIDATION.

pieces._comment: North wall run: 4 straight wall segments stepping +1024 along X. WRCWall* = Whiterun city wall STAT family (PLACEHOLDER — validate exact EditorID).
Four corner towers. WRCTower* PLACEHOLDER — validate.
Gatehouse on the front (south) edge centre, ground-anchored. WRCGate* PLACEHOLDER — validate.
Central keep. WhiterunKeep / Dragonsreach exterior STAT PLACEHOLDER — validate.

_known_limits: No distant LOD (structure vanishes outside the active 5x5 grid; keep footprint <= 3x3 cells). No runtime navmesh (NPCs can't path; player can walk it). Terrain is only VISUALLY levelled via flatten_to_max + ground-anchored foundations — the heightmap is not modified (PROCGEN_EXTERIOR.md §3).
